rationale: TensorSchedule defaults direct_gemm to true, and ordinary plan_cuda uses that BASELINE_SCHEDULE. Existing layout and GEMM legality checks select direct execution when supported; direct_gemm=false retains the explicit packed comparison path.
revisit_condition: Revisit when direct-GEMM legality, layout eligibility, or baseline policy changes; preserve the explicit packed opt-out and do not treat the already-default dimension as an unqualified opt-in.
